maria_g: Heads up — we promoted zenith-13B (q4 PTQ) to staged yesterday and seeing two things:
- intermittent latency spikes on completions >1k tokens (p95 up to 4800ms vs expected 900ms)
- tokenizer oddness: emoji like :party_parrot: split into 3 tokens, leads to duplicated emojis in outputs sometimes

devin_w: Can you paste a short repro and logs? Is this only on dedicated or also hosted?

maria_g: Repro snippet below (ran on dedicated/staging). Also pasted a perf trace & stdout tail.

```
# repro
python examples/generate.py --model zenith-13b --quant q4 --prompt "Tell a long story..." --max_tokens 1500
```

perf trace excerpt:
```
[2026-11-04T09:22:11Z] request_id=abcd1234 latency=4821ms tokens_out=1401 kv_cache_miss=1
[2026-11-04T09:22:11Z] kernel=matmul_throughput fallback=true
```

stdout tail:
```
... Party! \ud83d\udc4f\ud83d\udc4f\ud83d\udc4f
... Party! \ud83d\udc4f\ud83d\udc4f\ud83d\udc4f
```

devin_w: Hmm looks like tokenization -> unicode surrogate pairs? Might be our tokenizer binding for emoji. Can you run `python -c "import tokenizers; print(tokenizers.__version__)"` on that node?

raj_p: Also suspect KV cache growth for long contexts with q4 path — we've seen extra allocations when quant path uses fallback matmuls. Can you collect `nvidia-smi pmon` during a spike? Also share the model config used for compilation (seq_len, block_size, use_kv_cache true).

sara_eval: Eval summary (nightly): zenith-13B-q4 has a +3.2% perplexity vs baseline on long-docs eval set and rag-led churn increase on the summarization prompt set. Not catastrophic but correlates with these reports. See run 2026-11-03-zenith13b-q4 in evals dashboard.

infra-bot: deploy:zenith-13b-q4 promoted to staging by @maria_g at 2026-11-03T18:42:00Z

eval-bot: regression alert: zenith-13b-q4 failed 8/120 evals (delta > 2sigma) — links: https://evals.redwood/zenith13b/q4/20261103

maria_g: Plan proposed:
1) back out quant kernel selection to fallback=off for a few hours to see if latency stabilizes
2) run tokenizer test across a sample of multi-byte unicode (emojis, CJK) on both host and dedicated nodes
3) reproduce with `--no-kv-cache` to see if duplication persists

devin_w: For immediate triage I can patch tokenizer binding on one node and run the tokenization test. If duplication stops, we ship a hotfix. If not, we try kernel revert.

raj_p: I'll collect pmon + perf counters and add HVX tracing. Assigning to @raj_p and @devin_w. If we confirm allocation leak, we'll revert to previous quant-profile and roll back.

sara_eval: Add a quick A/B eval for generated quality between the two builds (q4 vs q4-kernel-revert) on the problematic prompt set. I can run that after repro.

maria_g: Thanks. I'll attach the sample logs to the ticket and add everything to the onboarding checklist: tokenizer-smoke, kv-cache-smoke, perf-trace, eval-run. Will update thread in an hour.

devin_w: ping me when logs are up. :mag:

maria_g: uploaded logs to ticket #INC-5672 and added mp4 of perf flamegraph (link)

raj_p: got pmon, starting HVX trace now — ETA 25m

eval-bot: note: nightly eval rerun scheduled on dedicated: 2026-11-04T10:00:00Z

maria_g: Last update: traced a tokenizer binding mismatch — appears an upstream tokenizers wheel on that image is 0.12.1 while we expect 0.13.4. Patching to 0.13.4 fixes emoji split locally. Latency still slightly elevated on very long contexts; continuing trace.

devin_w: great catch. Can we add tokenizer version check to onboarding smoke? `smoke/tokenizer_version_check.sh` :+1:

maria_g: Will do. Adding to onboarding checklist: "verify tokenizers>=0.13.4 on all images" and "run long-context kv-cache smoke (1.5k tokens)".

raj_p: If kernel fallback persists after tokenizer fix, plan B is rollback quant profile and schedule a quant-kernel test matrix on the infra lab.

maria_g: Closing loop for now — new action items filed in INC-5672. Will follow up with final root cause once traces analyzed.

sara_eval: Thanks team. Leaving postmortem checklist items: update onboarding playbook, add tokenizer version gate, add long-context eval set to smoke tests.

maria_g: :sparkles:
